source: roadmap §9 as of commit 8b881ed3 (the data plane's Redis credential read-only); CoCache 8.1.0 read-only stores
statement: A process that does not run the control plane reads the snapshot documents and the candidates read-only, so a Redis user with read permission on them is enough and Redis refuses it a write; a process that runs the control plane writes them. Which one a process is follows the condition the control plane is wired on and nothing else (its classes on the classpath, and cosec.control.enabled not false, read the same from a property or the environment): a cocache.* property or customizer that changes it, either way, fails the creation of the store.
